SELECT COALESCE(SUM(shipping_minor), 0) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
       AS shipping_dollars
FROM orders
WHERE placed_at >= '2026-03-01'
  AND placed_at < '2026-04-01';

    FROM shop_meta
    WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
);

    category,
    ROUND(AVG(price_minor) / CAST(
        (SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
        AS REAL
    ), 2) AS average_list_price_dollars
FROM products
GROUP BY category;

SELECT
    p.name AS product_name,
    1.0 * p.price_minor / CAST(m.value AS INTEGER) AS list_price_dollars,
    1.0 * MIN(oi.unit_price_minor) / CAST(m.value AS INTEGER) AS lowest_price_paid_dollars
FROM products AS p
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'kitchen_dining'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price_minor, m.value
ORDER BY p.name, p.id;

SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS refund_count,
    SUM(amount_minor) * 1.0 / (
        SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
    ) AS total_refunded_dollars
FROM refunds
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', created_at)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT ROUND(
    AVG(merchandise_minor) /
    (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'),
    2
) AS avg_merchandise_value_dollars
FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'canceled'
    GROUP BY o.id
);

SELECT
    p.category,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
        (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
         FROM shop_meta
         WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS revenue_dollars
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.country = 'DEU'
  AND o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        category,
        revenue_minor,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
    month,
    category,
    revenue_minor / (
        SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
    ) AS revenue_dollars
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

WITH merchandise AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS total_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT c.name,
       SUM(COALESCE(m.total_minor, 0) + o.shipping_minor) * 1.0
           / CAST((SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS INTEGER)
           AS total_dollars
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN merchandise AS m ON m.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(m.total_minor, 0) + o.shipping_minor) DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete'
        THEN COALESCE(i.revenue_minor, 0) - COALESCE(r.refund_minor, 0)
        ELSE 0
    END) / (
        SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
    ) AS net_amount_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN item_totals AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

SELECT
    c.name AS customer_name,
    CAST(
        julianday(date(MIN(o.placed_at))) - julianday(date(c.signup_date))
        AS INTEGER
    ) AS days_to_first_order
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.segment = 'reseller_partner'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.signup_date
ORDER BY days_to_first_order, c.name, c.id;

reply:
SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY total_units DESC, p.name ASC
LIMIT 4;

reply:
SELECT
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.price_minor * 1.0 / CAST(m.value AS INTEGER) AS list_price_dollars,
    MIN(oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 / CAST(m.value AS INTEGER) AS lowest_price_paid_dollars
FROM products AS p
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'kitchen_dining'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price_minor, m.value;

ORDER BY month;

SELECT ROUND(
    AVG(merchandise_minor) /
    (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'),
    2
) AS average_merchandise_value_dollars
FROM (
    SELECT o.id, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'canceled'
    GROUP BY o.id
) AS canceled_orders;

       SUM(o.shipping_minor) / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'

WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
           p.category,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month, category, revenue_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM category_revenue
)
SELECT month,
       category,
       revenue_minor * 1.0 / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       ) AS revenue_dollars
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id

  )
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) = 6;

           status,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

WITH merchandise AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS total_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT c.name AS customer_name,
       SUM(COALESCE(m.total_minor, 0) + o.shipping_minor) /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS total_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN merchandise AS m ON m.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(m.total_minor, 0) + o.shipping_minor) DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

WITH item_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS refund_minor
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete'
             THEN COALESCE(i.revenue_minor, 0) - COALESCE(r.refund_minor, 0)
             ELSE 0
        END) / (
            SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
            FROM shop_meta
            WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
        ) AS net_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN item_totals AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at)
ORDER BY month;

    p.name AS product_name,
    ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2)

       > 45 * COUNT(*);

SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY total_units DESC, p.name ASC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.price_minor * 1.0 / m.value AS list_price_dollars,
    MIN(oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 / m.value AS lowest_price_paid_dollars
FROM products AS p
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'kitchen_dining'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price_minor, m.value
ORDER BY p.name, p.id;

SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS refund_count,
    SUM(amount_minor) * 1.0 / (
        SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
    ) AS total_refunded_dollars
FROM refunds
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', created_at)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT
    p.category,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
        CAST((SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS INTEGER)
        AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.country = 'DEU'
  AND o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;

WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'

    category,

        SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
        FROM shop_meta

FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

WITH merchandise AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS subtotal_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT c.name AS customer_name,
       SUM(COALESCE(m.subtotal_minor, 0) + o.shipping_minor) * 1.0
           / (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
              FROM shop_meta
              WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS total_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN merchandise AS m ON m.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(m.subtotal_minor, 0) + o.shipping_minor) DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

WITH item_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS refund_minor
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete'
                THEN COALESCE(i.revenue_minor, 0) - COALESCE(r.refund_minor, 0)
                ELSE 0
           END) / (
               SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
               FROM shop_meta
               WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
           ) AS net_amount_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN item_totals AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT
    p.name AS product_name,
    ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS below_list_pct
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING 100 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 45 * COUNT(*);

SELECT
    c.name AS customer_name,
    CAST(JULIANDAY(DATE(MIN(o.placed_at))) - JULIANDAY(DATE(c.signup_date)) AS INTEGER) AS days_to_first_order
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.segment = 'reseller_partner'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.signup_date
ORDER BY days_to_first_order ASC, c.name ASC;
